title: Late or delayed orders
keywords: late delayed delivery tracking shipment order status courier
content: Open Orders in your ShopEase account and select the order to review its latest tracking status and estimated delivery date. Carrier updates may take time to appear.

title: Returns and refunds
keywords: return refund damaged wrong item eligibility return window
content: Open the order details and choose Return or Refund if the option is available. Follow the displayed instructions and retain the return confirmation until the refund is processed.

title: Contacting customer support
keywords: contact support help representative order number escalation problem
content: If self-service steps do not resolve the issue, contact ShopEase customer support and provide the order number, a short description of the problem, and any relevant tracking or return reference.

title: Cancelling an order
content: Open the order details and check whether Cancel Order is available. If the order has already been dispatched, cancellation may no longer be available; contact customer support for the available options.

title: Payment and failed transactions
keywords: payment failed transaction charged card debit payment method checkout
content: If a payment fails, check whether your bank or payment provider shows a completed charge before trying again. If an amount was debited but the order was not created, keep the transaction reference and request customer support to review it.

title: Changing a delivery address
keywords: change update edit delivery shipping address order
content: Open the order details and check whether the delivery address can still be edited. Address changes may be unavailable after an order has been packed or dispatched; request customer support if the edit option is no longer shown.
